A new physical startup surrogate, if justified, requires a new model/schema and qualification, not numerical event-v2 relabeling

Tool/model version and declaration provenance, or equivalent independently verified interface metadata

Licensed local tool availability and operator-authorized execution

trace_settling_contract.criterion: After last source-state change, observe two full windows W and2W. Both rails in both windows must pass voltage peak-to-peak, linear slope×window span, energy drift and signed integral-current versus capacitor-charge consistency. At least8 full-resolution samples and declared maximum sample spacing in each window. Short trace is insufficient, not settled.
trace_settling_contract.meaning: Settled only over observed declared windows; no guessed fixed startup/discharge time, asymptotic claim or identification of released-energy destination
trace_settling_contract.no_native_result: Four synthetic tests verify validator behavior only; their numeric windows/tolerances do not become native criteria
trace_settling_contract.selection: Fixture owner must bind all tolerances and window before native execution; no numeric defaults or result-dependent relaxation
